identity.name: AirYatra Design System
identity.theme_source: Vaayu Prive Gamma deck (look only; the product name stays AirYatra). See docs/AirYatra_Refurbish_Master_Prompt.md section C.4.
identity.vibe: Dark, premium night-flight luxury with a single high-energy lime accent; editorial, data-forward, safety and trust first.

usage_rules: h1 and h2 are Barlow Condensed 800, UPPERCASE, line-height 1.05 (set globally in index.css).
Overlines: a short lime bar, then a JetBrains Mono uppercase label in muted text, then the headline. Use the .ay-overline class.
Use JetBrains Mono for numbers, codes (PNR, flight no., tail no.), prices in tables and card titles.
Never set long body copy in Barlow Condensed.
typography.installation: Loaded in public/index.html from Google Fonts with display=swap: Barlow Condensed 700/800, IBM Plex Sans 400/500/600, JetBrains Mono 500/600.

surface.usage: Cards, panels, text boxes over photos

text_subtle.usage: Tertiary text; still AA on page and cards

lime.usage: One primary action or highlight per view (Book now, selected fare, Safety Score). Text on lime is always #000000.

amber.usage: Links and small highlights only: warnings, rating stars

destructive.usage: Errors and destructive actions, white text

colors.slate_remap: tailwind.config.js maps the whole slate scale onto the aubergine scale (50 #F8F6FA ... 950 #0F0B15), so existing slate-* classes follow the theme.
colors.light_theme: Invert surfaces: #F2EEF6 page, #FFFFFF cards, #17111F text, #5A5068 muted text. Lime only as a fill with black text (lime text on white fails contrast).
rules: Do not hard-code hex values in components; use the tokens above.
Lime is never used for large text blocks or as text on light backgrounds.
Every text/background pair must meet WCAG AA; ratios are listed in docs/design/THEME.md.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Not used. Over photos, use a solid #221A2D panel instead.

spacing.scale: Generous. Use p-8 or p-12 where others use p-4.

grids.marketing: The Tetris Grid (Asymmetrical). Mix col-span-8 (Hero) with col-span-4 (Detail).
grids.dashboard: The Control Room Grid. Dense, 4-column layout. Gap-4. 100% width utilization.

alignment.text: Left aligned mostly. Center only for massive hero slogans.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground (lime with black text), square corners (rounded-sm), font-semibold.

cards.default: bg-card border border-border rounded-sm, no shadow.
cards.featured: One lime card per grid: bg-lime text-black.

inputs.default: bg-background border-input rounded-sm, focus ring in lime (ring-ring).

motion.hover_effects: Colour change only; no lift or shadow.

media.style: Real aviation photography: helicopters on the apron at golden hour, private jets, pilots walking to aircraft, engineers servicing engines. Full-bleed photo with a solid dark panel for text, or photo left and dark content right.

design_system.iconography: Lucide-React thin line icons, lime on dark for feature grids.
universal_guidelines: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
For Dashboards: dense 4-column grid, gap-4, full width.
For Marketing: asymmetric grid with large photography.
Dark mode is the default everywhere and mandatory for the Operator Dashboard.
